items.text: Low-capital service businesses such as tutoring, repair, cleaning, catering, event support and digital services can start with a small test, and any franchise offer should be checked for real costs, support, territory rights and the experience of existing franchisees before you pay.
Test a service with a few paying customers first, count all costs and time and treat any franchise as a contract to read carefully.
Check them with the relevant authority and read franchise agreements fully.
